rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an act or habitual pattern of failing to give proper care or attention.

example.english: Their neglect of the elderly caused a lot of trouble.

rows.note: Use this for the general state of something or someone receiving no attention or consideration.

example.english: This issue has suffered neglect for a long time.

rows.note: Use this slice of being neglected when a person is socially ignored, left out, or treated with indifference.

example.english: After changing jobs, they suffered neglect at the new company.
